COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated CRP, suggesting an inflammatory or infectious process. Monocytosis and basophilia are present. Cardiac and liver markers are within normal limits, and renal function is preserved. Ferritin is at the upper normal limit, possibly reflecting inflammation. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or coagulopathy. Clinical correlation is recommended, especially regarding respiratory status and possible infection or inflammation.
